      -(3/2) * inner ?q ?p - (1/2) * (norm (?p - ?q))\<^sup>2"
    using interp[of x0 ?y] ypos
    by (simp add: inner_scaleR_right; nlinarith)

      inner ?q (?d - (3/2) *\<^sub>R ?p) - (1/2) * (norm ?q)\<^sup>2"
